scripts.auth:login: COOKIE=/tmp/personarum.cookies; rm -f "$COOKIE"; CSRF=$(curl -fsS -c "$COOKIE" http://localhost:8080/api/auth/csrf | sed -n 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); curl -fsS -b "$COOKIE" -c "$COOKIE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-CSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF" -d "{\"username\":\"${PERSONARUM_USERNAME:-admin}\",\"password\":\"${PERSONARUM_PASSWORD:-ADMIN_PASSWORD_007}\"}" http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login; echo
scripts.auth:logout: COOKIE=/tmp/personarum.cookies; CSRF=$(curl -fsS -b "$COOKIE" -c "$COOKIE" http://localhost:8080/api/auth/csrf | sed -n 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' -b "$COOKIE" -c "$COOKIE" -H "X-CSRF-TOKEN: $CSRF" -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/logout
